name: PICO-8 for Leaf
summary: Browse Splore and play your PICO-8 carts natively.
description: Adds Splore in Apps and native PICO-8 in the Core picker on MLP1. You purchase PICO-8 separately and copy the Raspberry Pi runtime to your primary card. FAKE-08 stays your default until you choose native PICO-8.
author: Utility Muffin Research Kitchen
